description:
Astraea, the strongest swordswoman in the world. One day, she realizes that she has reincarnated as a character inside a novel. And that role is the one who gets killed by the Evil God, the final boss...

During a mountain hike, she saves a child from assailants, only to learn that this very child is destined to become the Evil God.

 *"Well then, since it’s come to this, how about I raise him properly and reform him?"*

So she takes the child in and begins to raise him. But then... 

 *"Rea. Where are you going? Are you meeting that guy again?"* 

The boy has grown into an obsessive man who follows her everywhere, watching her every move. Somehow... it feels like she raised him the wrong way. 

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
